page: Microsoft Azure NC16as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCASv3_T4 family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor on the x86_64 architecture, managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 110.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.88 GB of RAM per core.

This server type integrates a single NVIDIA T4 graphics processing unit with 15 GB of dedicated video RAM. For local storage, the instance includes a 360 GB local disk and is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration balances dedicated AMD CPU cores with a single NVIDIA T4 GPU, positioning it as a resource-dense option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the cost overhead of high-end enterprise GPUs. The combination of 110.0 GB of system memory and dedicated GPU resources makes this instance suitable for machine learning inference, light training tasks, video encoding, and graphics rendering workloads.
